findings.summary: No loading state is rendered while the overview query is fetching; when data is undefined and there is no error the metrics grid, pulse, priorities and scope sections all render empty/blank with zero feedback to the user.
findings.fix: Add a loading branch (e.g. after the hero, when query.isLoading show skeleton MetricCards or a 'جارٍ تحميل اللوحة…' placeholder consistent with the app's loading text pattern) so the dashboard body is not blank during fetch.

findings.summary: The hero description uses the hardcoded Tailwind color class text-blue-100 instead of a design token, bypassing the token system used elsewhere.
findings.fix: Replace text-blue-100 with a token-based hero-foreground color (e.g. a dedicated CSS class like .hero-eyebrow already used above, or a token var) so the hero text color is centralized and theme-aware.

findings.summary: The error state uses a full EmptyState card but the metrics/pulse/priorities sections still render below it (empty), producing an inconsistent error screen versus other pages that short-circuit the body on error.
findings.fix: When query.isError, return early after the hero + EmptyState (or hide the metric/pulse/priority sections) so only the error card shows, matching the app's error-handling pattern.

findings.summary: The pulse progress bars convey their value only via bar width and a numeric badge with no ARIA progress semantics, so assistive tech reads them as decorative divs.
findings.fix: Add role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow/aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax (and aria-label from item.label) to the .progress-track element so screen readers announce each pulse metric.

findings.summary: Hero quick-action Links lack any aria-label/title and rely solely on visible text plus an icon; acceptable but the icon has no aria-hidden so it may be announced redundantly.
findings.fix: Add aria-hidden="true" to the decorative <Icon> inside each hero-action (and in priority-item / pulse rows) to prevent redundant icon announcements.
